comment: Independent C-first positional correction for the Purple Worm M-to-M AD_DGST probe. The prior C map showed the Stone Golem at x4 and hero at x2 after the west move, separated by the stair at x3. This correction retains the source-selected seed/date/options and removes only that west move, leaving the hero at x3 beside the observed x4 Stone Golem before the worm is created. C must establish the resulting monster positions, adjacency, and actual attack direction; count no engulf or AD_DGST branch unless the C trace reaches it. The intended C route is a Purple Worm AT_ENGL attack against an eligible MZ_LARGE Stone Golem, then mhitm.c:gulpmm -> mhitm.c:mdamagem -> uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping -> uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_dgst.
